caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition with several geometric and symbolic elements in warm colors. At the top center, there is a large cross shape outlined in red with a gold interior, decorated with blue accents and surrounded by short gold lines radiating outward. Below the cross is a bow-like element with four loops, each outlined in blue with a red interior filled with gold dots. At the center of this bow is a blue ring with a small circular design inside. On each side, behind the bow shape, are two gold wing-like shapes with brown tips, resembling stylized feathers or leaves. Prominently filling the lower half of the composition is a large circular mandala pattern outlined in red, featuring alternating blue, gold, and red petal and diamond shapes radiating from a central circle. The background is an off-white, textured surface resembling aged paper. The overall color scheme consists of gold, red, blue, and subtle hints of off-white.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
